surface_verification.detail: The real CLI driven against the REAL repository's real event log (831+ entries): exit 0, and the rebuilt .shipwright/runtime/events-context-index.json shows the fix live on production data -- commit.missing=3 (was structurally uncountable before this fix), commit.not_applicable=327, area_ids.missing=0 (the false-alarm this iterate exists to prevent, confirmed absent), supersedes_event_id.missing=0 (the 503/831 false-alarm this iterate's design avoids, confirmed absent), missing_work_completed.count=33 (the genuinely actionable subset, capped at 50, not truncated).

behaviors.behavior: unavailable splits into not_applicable (no run_id/commit linkage) vs missing (linked, unresolved)
eligibility is derived from the entry's own data, never a hardcoded event-type list -- a brand-new event type this test has never seen before lands in not_applicable
per-entry provenance vocabulary (declared/derived/unavailable) is unchanged -- the split is envelope-level only
behaviors.evidence: test_event_context_coverage_envelope.py::test_empty_diff_backfilled_commit_does_not_false_flag_area_ids_as_missing PASSED (asserts entry["provenance"]["area_ids"] == "unavailable" unchanged while the envelope bucket differs)

behaviors.behavior: coverage.missing_work_completed surfaces the genuinely actionable subset, most-recent-first, capped and flagged when truncated
a declared commit without a run_id is still eligible for missing (eligibility is commit-OR-run_id, not run_id-only)
a field with no independent eligibility signal (supersedes_event_id) never lands in missing -- avoids a 503/831 false alarm
a field wholly derived from another field (area_ids from changed_files) never lands in missing on its own -- avoids the empty-diff false alarm this iterate exists to fix
MISSING_ELIGIBLE_FIELDS stays a subset of PROVENANCE_FIELDS -- a future field not added to it fails safe (not_applicable-only), not silently invisible
the aggregate split is proven live against the real production event log (831+ entries), not only synthetic fixtures
